reviewer: Project review after the browser verdict, written with Claude Code (the AI assistant that built this project). A reading of the patch, not another test.
verdict: Works, with a visible change to the default display
summary: A configured dateFormat (function or Intl options) is still applied first; only the default formatting of an input datepicker changes from locale text to YYYY-MM-DD, so focusing no longer rewrites a saved ISO value.
caveats: Every input datepicker without a dateFormat now shows ISO dates instead of locale text.
The pending human fixes keep the locale display and submit ISO through a hidden input; this patch changes what users see instead.
